title: Mastruq Champion / Ixt Hsek Syat
summary: Honor the arena's opening duel, then fight the champion and Ixt Hsek Syat inside the pit.
overview: Honor the arena's opening duel, then fight the champion and Ixt Hsek Syat inside the pit.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Choose one duelist and avoid pets or outside healing that could join the Runt's hate list.
After the duel, assign both bosses and the remaining arena adds.

phases.label: The duel
phases.description: A single combatant must defeat the Runt without assistance.

phases.label: Arena finale
phases.description: Control both named opponents and the fighters they call.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Entering the arena starts the dialogue and summons the Runt for a solo challenge.
More than one entry on the Runt's hate list counts as cheating and activates the spectators and champion.
Killing the Runt summons Ixt and makes the champion vulnerable.
At 90%, Ixt calls the remaining arena fighters; at 20%, he calls the champion if free. The champion also calls Ixt at 20%.
The arena opponents return and reset hate when pulled outside the pit.

notes: Approval E382. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
